bot.name: Sunny
bot.greeting: Hi, I'm Sunny, ShopEasy's help assistant. Ask me about orders, delivery, returns, payments or your account. I'll find the right answer for you.
bot.fallback: I couldn't find a confident answer to that. You can rephrase it, pick a topic on the left, or reach our support team at **support@shopeasy.example** / **1800-123-456** (Mon–Sat, 9am–6pm).

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
variants: Where is my order right now?
I want to check the status of my package
Is there a tracking link for my shipment?
faqs.answer: Open **My Orders**, pick the order and tap **Track**. Once it ships you'll also get a tracking link by email and SMS, and the courier's live status shows on the same page.
faqs.keywords: track tracking status where order package

faqs.question: My order is late. What should I do?
variants: The expected delivery date has passed
My package hasn't moved for days
faqs.answer: Delays usually come from courier backlogs or weather. If your order is more than **2 days past** the promised date, open **My Orders → Report Issue → Delayed delivery**. We'll chase the courier and you can cancel for a full refund if it hasn't shipped yet.
faqs.keywords: late delayed delay slow overdue stuck expected date taking long time

faqs.question: My order says delivered but I didn't receive it
variants: Tracking shows delivered but nothing arrived
I never got my parcel even though it says delivered
faqs.answer: Please check with neighbours or your building security first. If it still isn't found, report it within **48 hours** from **My Orders → Report Issue → Not received**. We'll investigate with the courier and send a replacement or refund within 5 working days.
faqs.keywords: delivered not received missing never got stolen lost

faqs.question: How do I cancel my order?
variants: I want to cancel an order I just placed
How to call off my purchase
faqs.answer: Go to **My Orders**, open the order and tap **Cancel** — this works until the order ships. After it ships you can refuse the delivery or start a return once it arrives. Prepaid orders are refunded automatically after cancellation.
faqs.keywords: cancel cancellation stop undo

faqs.question: When will I get my money back after cancelling?
variants: I cancelled but have not received the refund
faqs.answer:
For a cancelled prepaid order the refund starts immediately:
- **UPI / wallet:** within 24 hours
- **Cards / net banking:** 3–5 business days
- **ShopEasy Wallet:** instant
faqs.keywords: cancelled refund money back cancellation

faqs.question: Can I change items in an order I already placed?
variants: Add another product to my existing order
Change the size or colour after ordering
faqs.answer: Orders can't be edited once placed, but you can cancel it from **My Orders** (before it ships) and place a new one with the right items. Any coupon used is returned to your account automatically.
faqs.keywords: modify edit change add item size colour quantity

faqs.question: Where can I see my past orders?
faqs.answer: All your orders — current and past — are under **Account → My Orders**. Use the filter at the top to search by date, status or product name.
faqs.keywords: past previous old history orders list

faqs.question: How do I download the invoice for my order?
variants: I need a GST bill for my purchase
Get a receipt for my order
faqs.answer: Open the order in **My Orders** and tap **Download invoice**. It becomes available once the order is shipped. For a GST invoice, add your GSTIN under **Account → Business details** before checkout.
faqs.keywords: invoice bill receipt gst gstin tax download

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer:
**Standard delivery:** 3–7 business days.
**Express delivery:** 1–2 business days in major cities.
The exact date for your pincode is shown on the product page before you buy.
faqs.keywords: delivery time days long arrive soon when shipping

faqs.question: Do you offer express or same-day delivery?
variants: Can I get my order faster?
faqs.answer: Yes. **Express (1–2 days)** costs Rs. 79 and **Same-day** delivery is Rs. 149 in Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune for orders placed before 12 noon. Plus members get express delivery free.
faqs.keywords: express fast faster same day next day quick urgent tomorrow

faqs.question: Do you offer free shipping?
faqs.answer: Orders above **Rs. 499** get free standard shipping. Below that, a Rs. 40 delivery fee applies. Plus members get free shipping on every order.
faqs.keywords: free shipping charges fee cost delivery charge minimum

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
variants: Do you ship to the USA?
faqs.answer: Right now we deliver only within India. International shipping is planned — you can turn on **Account → Notifications → New regions** to hear when it launches.
faqs.keywords: international abroad overseas country outside

faqs.question: Do you deliver to my pincode?
variants: Is delivery available in my area?
Check if you service my location
You don't deliver to my city
faqs.answer: Enter your pincode in the **Check delivery** box on any product page. We cover 19,000+ pincodes across India; if yours isn't serviceable yet, the box will tell you and you can request it.
faqs.keywords: pincode area city town location serviceable available village

faqs.question: Can I change my delivery address?
variants: Update the shipping address on my order
faqs.answer: Yes, until the order ships: **My Orders → Edit address**. After it ships the courier can't reroute it, so please contact support and we'll try to help.
faqs.keywords: address change update wrong location deliver different office home

faqs.question: I missed the delivery. What happens now?
variants: Courier came when I was not home
faqs.answer: The courier makes **3 attempts** on consecutive working days and calls you before each one. You can also pick a new slot from the tracking page. After 3 failed attempts the order returns to us and prepaid amounts are refunded.
faqs.keywords: missed attempt failed not home reattempt reschedule

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
variants: How many days do I have to return an item?
faqs.answer: Most items can be returned within **30 days** of delivery in their original condition with tags and packaging. Some items are not returnable — see *non-returnable items*. Start a return from **My Orders → Return item**.
faqs.keywords: return policy days window period time limit eligible

faqs.question: How do I return an item?
variants: Steps to send a product back
How does pickup for returns work
faqs.answer:
1. Go to **My Orders** and open the item.
2. Tap **Return item** and choose a reason.
3. Pick a pickup slot — our courier collects it from your door for free.
4. Pack it in the original box; the refund starts after quality check.
faqs.keywords: return steps pickup process start process procedure

faqs.question: How long does a refund take?
variants: When will I get my money back for a return?
faqs.answer:
Refunds start within **48 hours** of the returned item passing quality check, then take:
- **UPI / wallet:** 1–2 days
- **Cards / net banking:** 5–7 business days
- **Cash on Delivery orders:** to your bank account or ShopEasy Wallet, your choice
faqs.keywords: refund time long days money back when

faqs.question: How do I get a refund for a Cash on Delivery order?
variants: I paid cash, how is it refunded?
faqs.answer: For COD orders, choose **Bank account** or **ShopEasy Wallet** when you raise the return. Bank refunds need your account number and IFSC (entered securely in the app, never by chat) and arrive in 5–7 business days. Wallet refunds are instant.
faqs.keywords: cod cash refund bank ifsc

faqs.question: Can I exchange an item for a different size?
variants: The size doesn't fit, can I swap it?
faqs.answer: Yes — clothing and footwear can be exchanged once within **30 days**. Open **My Orders → Exchange**, pick the new size or colour, and we'll pick up the old one when we deliver the new one. If the new size is out of stock, you can return it for a refund instead.
faqs.keywords: exchange size fit swap colour replace

faqs.question: Which items cannot be returned?
variants: Are there products I can't send back?
faqs.answer:
For hygiene and safety reasons these can't be returned unless damaged or wrong:
- Innerwear, swimwear and socks
- Cosmetics and personal care that has been opened
- Grocery and perishables
- Gift cards and digital products
The product page always says *Not returnable* when this applies.
faqs.keywords: non returnable cannot return exceptions innerwear cosmetics

faqs.question: What if I receive a damaged or wrong product?
variants: I got a different item than I ordered
faqs.answer: Sorry about that. Report it within **48 hours** from **My Orders → Report issue** with a photo of the product and packaging. We'll send a free replacement or a full refund — your choice — and pick up the faulty one.
faqs.keywords: damaged broken defective wrong incorrect faulty

faqs.question: My return pickup didn't happen
variants: Nobody came to collect my return
faqs.answer: Open the return in **My Orders** and tap **Reschedule pickup** to choose a new slot. If the courier misses it twice, we'll give you a self-ship option with the shipping cost credited to your wallet.
faqs.keywords: pickup missed reschedule collect return courier

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, Amex), **UPI**, net banking, popular wallets, **EMI**, ShopEasy Wallet and **Cash on Delivery**.
faqs.keywords: payment methods options pay card upi netbanking

faqs.question: Is Cash on Delivery available?
variants: Can I pay when the product arrives?
Is COD available for my order?
Pay in cash at my door
faqs.answer: Yes, for orders up to **Rs. 50,000** on most pincodes. A Rs. 20 COD handling fee applies. You can pay the courier in cash or by scanning their UPI QR code.
faqs.keywords: cod cash delivery pay door

faqs.question: Can I pay in EMI?
faqs.answer: Yes. EMI is available on orders above Rs. 3,000 with major credit cards and select debit cards. Look for **No-cost EMI** on the product page — the interest is covered by us on eligible products. Pay Later options are shown at checkout if you're eligible.
faqs.keywords: emi installment monthly no cost pay later credit

faqs.question: My payment failed but money was deducted
variants: Amount debited but order not placed
Transaction failed but I was charged
faqs.answer: Don't worry — if the order wasn't confirmed, your bank automatically reverses the amount within **5–7 business days**. If it hasn't returned by then, share the transaction reference with support and we'll trace it for you.
faqs.keywords: payment failed deducted debited charged twice double money cut

faqs.question: Is my payment information secure?
variants: Is it safe to use my card here?
Do you store my card details?
How do you protect payment data
faqs.answer: Yes. Payments are encrypted end-to-end and processed by PCI-DSS compliant gateways. We never store your full card number or CVV, and saved cards are tokenised as per RBI guidelines.
faqs.keywords: secure safe security card details store protect

faqs.question: How do I use a coupon code?
variants: Where do I enter a promo code?
Apply a discount code at checkout
faqs.answer: Enter the code in the **Apply coupon** box on the checkout page and tap **Apply**. The discount shows before you pay. Only one coupon can be used per order.
faqs.keywords: coupon code apply promo voucher discount redeem

faqs.question: Why is my coupon not working?
faqs.answer:
Check these common reasons:
- The cart is below the coupon's minimum value
- The coupon has expired or was already used
- Some products (like gift cards) are excluded
- It's valid only for certain payment methods
The exact reason shows under the coupon box when you tap **Apply**.
faqs.keywords: coupon not working invalid expired error apply

faqs.question: Are there any sales or offers right now?
faqs.answer: Live deals, bank offers and upcoming sale dates are on the **Offers** tab of the app and website. Turn on **Notifications → Deals** to get a heads-up before big sales start.
faqs.keywords: offers sale deals discount today bank

faqs.question: What is ShopEasy Plus membership?
faqs.answer:
**ShopEasy Plus** costs Rs. 499 a year and gives you:
- Free shipping on every order
- Free express delivery
- Early access to sales
- 5% back as EasyCash on every purchase
Cancel anytime from **Account → Membership**.
faqs.keywords: plus membership subscription benefits cost premium

faqs.question: How does the ShopEasy Wallet work?
variants: How do I use my wallet balance?
faqs.answer: Your ShopEasy Wallet holds refunds and **EasyCash** rewards. At checkout it's applied automatically. Refund balance never expires; EasyCash rewards expire after 6 months, and the expiry date is shown in **Account → Wallet**.
faqs.keywords: wallet easycash balance credit expire use

faqs.question: Do you sell gift cards?
variants: Can I buy a gift voucher for a friend?
How to redeem a gift card
faqs.answer: Yes — e-gift cards from Rs. 250 to Rs. 10,000 are under **Gift cards** in the menu. They're emailed instantly and valid for 1 year. To redeem one, go to **Account → Wallet → Add gift card**.
faqs.keywords: gift card voucher egift redeem friend

faqs.question: Can I send an order as a gift?
variants: Hide the price on the package
faqs.answer: Yes. Tick **This is a gift** at checkout to add gift wrap (Rs. 35) and a personal message. The invoice won't be included in the box and prices are hidden from the packaging.
faqs.keywords: gift wrap message present hide price

faqs.question: How do I create an account?
variants: How to sign up on ShopEasy
Can I shop without an account?
faqs.answer: Tap **Sign up** at the top right, enter your name, mobile number or email and a password, then verify with the OTP we send. You can also check out as a guest, but you'll need an account to track returns and earn EasyCash.
faqs.keywords: create account sign up register new join guest

faqs.question: How can I reset my password?
variants: Can't log in to my account
faqs.answer: Tap **Forgot password** on the login page, enter your registered email or mobile number and follow the reset link or OTP. To change a password you remember, go to **Account → Security → Change password**.
faqs.keywords: password forgot reset login cannot sign in change locked out access

faqs.question: I'm not receiving the OTP
faqs.answer: Wait 60 seconds and tap **Resend OTP**. Check that the number is correct, you have network signal and that DND isn't blocking promotional senders. You can also choose **Get OTP on email** instead.
faqs.keywords: otp code sms verification not received resend

faqs.question: How do I change my phone number or email?
variants: Change the email on my account
faqs.answer: Go to **Account → Profile → Edit**. Changing your mobile number or email needs an OTP sent to both the old and the new contact, to keep your account safe.
faqs.keywords: change phone mobile number email profile update edit

faqs.question: How do I delete my account?
faqs.answer: Go to **Account → Privacy → Delete account**. Make sure you have no open orders or returns and that you've used your wallet balance — deletion is permanent and takes up to 7 days.
faqs.keywords: delete close deactivate remove account data privacy

faqs.question: I think my account was hacked
variants: Someone else logged into my account
I see orders I didn't place
Got a suspicious call asking for my OTP
faqs.answer: Change your password right away under **Account → Security** and tap **Log out of all devices**. Then contact support so we can freeze any suspicious orders. ShopEasy staff will **never** ask for your OTP, password or card PIN.
faqs.keywords: hacked suspicious unauthorized fraud scam secure security misuse using

faqs.question: Do products come with a warranty?
variants: My electronics stopped working after a month
faqs.answer: Electronics carry the **manufacturer's warranty** (usually 1 year) — the card is in the box and the period is listed on the product page. For a claim, contact the brand's service centre with your invoice from **My Orders**. Within 10 days of delivery, report it to us as a defective item instead.
faqs.keywords: warranty guarantee repair claim service centre stopped working

faqs.question: Are your products genuine?
variants: Is this an original product or fake?
faqs.answer: Yes. We source directly from brands and authorised sellers, and every seller is verified. If you ever receive something you believe isn't genuine, report it and we'll refund you in full.
faqs.keywords: genuine original authentic fake counterfeit real

faqs.question: When will an out-of-stock item be available again?
variants: Notify me when back in stock
faqs.answer: Tap **Notify me** on the product page and we'll send an alert as soon as it's back. We can't promise restock dates because they depend on the seller.
faqs.keywords: out of stock sold out restock available notify

faqs.question: How do I find my size?
faqs.answer: Every clothing and footwear page has a **Size chart** link under the size buttons, with measurements in cm and inches. Reviews often mention whether a product runs small or large. If it doesn't fit, you can exchange it free within 30 days.
faqs.keywords: size chart fit measurement which size small large

faqs.question: The price dropped after I bought it. Can I get the difference?
variants: Item is cheaper now than when I ordered
faqs.answer: We don't refund price differences on placed orders. If the order hasn't shipped, you can cancel and reorder at the new price. Add items to your **Wishlist** to get price-drop alerts in the future.
faqs.keywords: price drop difference cheaper match reduced

faqs.question: How can I sell my products on ShopEasy?
variants: List my business on your site
faqs.answer: Visit **sell.shopeasy.example** and register with your GSTIN, PAN and bank details. Approval takes 2–3 working days, after which you can list products from the Seller Hub.
faqs.keywords: sell seller vendor business list register merchant

faqs.question: How can I contact customer support?
variants: I want to talk to a human
faqs.answer:
You can reach us any of these ways:
- **Phone:** 1800-123-456 (Mon–Sat, 9am–6pm)
- **Email:** support@shopeasy.example (reply within 24 hours)
- **Live chat:** Help Centre → Chat with us
faqs.keywords: contact support help phone email call agent human talk

faqs.question: How do I raise a complaint?
variants: I'm not happy with the service
faqs.answer: Raise a ticket from **Help Centre → My tickets → New complaint** — you'll get a ticket ID and a reply within 48 hours. If it isn't resolved, you can escalate to our Grievance Officer at **grievance@shopeasy.example**.
faqs.keywords: complaint escalate unhappy grievance ticket issue bad service

faqs.question: Do you have physical stores?
variants: Is there a shop I can visit?
Can I pick up my order in person?
faqs.answer: ShopEasy is online-only, so there are no physical stores. In some cities you can choose a **Pickup Point** at checkout and collect your order from a partner shop near you.
faqs.keywords: store shop physical offline visit pickup point near me
